entity_title: Peru has no standalone work visa — it is the resident 'Trabajador' migratory status
fact_text: To work in Peru a foreigner obtains the resident 'Trabajador' migratory status (calidad migratoria) from Migraciones, not a separate 'work visa'. It is granted only to foreigners who already hold an employment contract, an administrative relationship, or a service-provision contract in the country.
evidence_quote: Esta visa se le otorga a aquellos extranjeros que tengan un contrato de trabajo, relación administrativa o contrato de prestación de servicios en el país.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: HR generalists look for a 'work visa'; in Peru the status hinges on an already-signed local contract/relationship, so the employer paperwork must exist before the migratory status can be requested.

entity_title: The resident-worker status must be requested from OUTSIDE Peru
fact_text: A condition for obtaining the resident-worker calidad migratoria via this procedure is that the applicant be located outside Peru. Entering as a tourist and switching in-country is a different 'cambio de calidad migratoria' procedure.
evidence_quote: Encontrarte fuera del país para la obtención de la calidad migratoria.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Assuming the hire can fly in and sort papers locally is a trap: this route requires the person to be abroad when the status is granted (i.e. visa approved before travel), so timing the relocation before the approval can strand the employee.

entity_title: A contract under 1 year (or with a trial period) downgrades the hire to 'trabajador temporal'
fact_text: For the resident-worker status the employment contract (approved by the labour authority) must state a term equal to or greater than one year. If the contract has a trial period or a term shorter than one year, Migraciones instead processes it as a temporary-worker (trabajador temporal) status.
evidence_quote: Si el contrato contempla periodos de prueba o el plazo sea inferior a 1 año, corresponde su evaluación como un procedimiento administrativo de solicitud de calidad migratoria trabajador temporal.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: A standard probation clause or a sub-12-month contract quietly changes the migratory category the employee ends up with; HR must draft the Peru contract at >=1 year with no trial period if the goal is resident status.

entity_title: 20% of headcount and 30% of payroll caps on foreign workers (D.L. 689)
fact_text: Under Decreto Legislativo N° 689, a Peruvian or foreign company may employ foreign workers up to 20% of its total staff, and their combined remuneration may not exceed 30% of the total payroll of wages and salaries.
evidence_quote: Las empresas nacionales o extranjeras podrán contratar personal extranjero en una proporción de hasta el 20% del número total de sus servidores, empleados y obreros. Sus remuneraciones no podrán exceder del 30% del total de la planilla de sueldos y salarios.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The classic Peru hiring trap: a small Peruvian subsidiary can legally be over the 20% headcount or 30% payroll cap the moment it hires one well-paid expat, blocking contract approval unless an exoneration applies.

entity_title: Foreign-worker contracts are fixed-term (max 3 years) and must include a commitment to train Peruvian staff
fact_text: Foreign-worker contracts under D.L. 689 must be in writing and for a fixed term of at most 3 years (renewable for equal successive periods), and must additionally record a commitment to train national personnel in the same occupation.
evidence_quote: Los contratos de trabajo a que se refiere la presente Ley deberán ser celebrados por escrito y a plazo determinado, por un período máximo de 3 años prorrogables, sucesivamente, por períodos iguales, debiendo constar además, el compromiso de capacitar al personal nacional en la misma ocupación.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Two non-obvious drafting requirements: the foreign hire cannot be on an open-ended (indefinite) contract, and the contract text itself must contain a knowledge-transfer/training clause or the labour authority will not approve it.

entity_title: Employers can request exoneration from the 20%/30% caps for specialized or management staff
fact_text: Employers may request an exoneration from the 20%/30% foreign-worker limits of Article 4 in defined cases, including specialized professional or technical personnel, and management/executive staff of a new business activity.
evidence_quote: Los empleadores podrán solicitar exoneración de los porcentajes limitativos prescritos en el artículo 4 de esta Ley, en los casos siguientes: a) Cuando se trate de personal profesional o técnico especializado;

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The escape hatch for corporate senior hires that would otherwise breach the cap: specialized/technical and executive roles can be exonerated, but it is a request the employer must actively file, not an automatic exemption.

entity_title: Migraciones resolves the resident-worker status within 30 calendar days
fact_text: After payment and document upload in Migraciones' online agency, the resident-worker calidad migratoria application receives a response within a maximum of 30 calendar days.
evidence_quote: Recibirás respuesta en un plazo máximo de 30 días calendario.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Relocation planning should assume up to 30 calendar days for the migratory decision alone, on top of the earlier labour-authority contract approval and the applicant being abroad while it runs.

entity_title: 183 days in any 12 months makes a foreigner tax-domiciled in Peru
fact_text: For income-tax purposes SUNAT treats a foreigner who has stayed in Peru more than 183 days within a 12-month period as domiciled (extranjero domiciliado); the 183-day count runs over any rolling 12 months, not the calendar tax year.
evidence_quote: Extranjero que permaneció en Perú más de 183 días en un periodo de 12 meses (extranjero domiciliado) y estuvo fuera la misma cantidad de días acumulados en 1 año.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The domicile line is 183 days across any rolling 12 months, not per calendar year, and crossing it changes the employee's tax status (and eventually worldwide-income exposure) independently of their migratory status.

entity_title: Non-domiciled employees on payroll suffer a flat 30% withholding
fact_text: While an employee is still non-domiciled (before crossing the 183-day threshold), fifth-category (payroll) income is subject to a 30% withholding by the employer, rather than the progressive rates that apply once domiciled.
evidence_quote: Rentas de 5ta categoría: si estás en planilla, tu empleador debe retenerte el 30% de tu pago.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: A newly-arrived expat is taxed at a flat 30% of gross salary during their first months (non-domiciled) — a large, surprising net-pay hit HR must flag and often gross up until domicile is reached the following tax year.

entity_title: EsSalud health contribution is 9%, employer-paid, floored at the minimum wage
fact_text: For dependent workers the EsSalud health contribution under Ley N° 26790 equals 9% of monthly remuneration, cannot be lower than the current Minimum Vital Remuneration, and is the mandatory obligation of the employer.
evidence_quote: es equivalente al 9% de la remuneración o ingreso mensual. Esta no puede ser menor a la Remuneración Mínima Vital (RMV) vigente (**) y está a cargo obligatorio de la entidad empleadora.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: The 9% health contribution is borne entirely by the employer (not split from salary) and has a floor of the minimum wage, so it is a real employer cost that applies to foreign dependent workers just as to Peruvians.

entity_title: Pension affiliation is mandatory; the worker has 10 days to choose ONP (SNP) or an AFP (SPP)
fact_text: Every employer must enrol staff in a pension system from the start of the employment relationship (if not already affiliated). After receiving the ONP information bulletin, the worker has 10 calendar days to state in writing whether they join the national system (SNP/ONP) or the private system (SPP/AFP).
evidence_quote: A partir de la entrega de dicho boletín, el trabajador tiene un plazo de 10 días calendarios para expresar por escrito su voluntad para incorporarse al SNP o al SPP.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Foreign dependent workers are not exempt from Peruvian pension enrolment; if the employee does not choose within 10 days the employer defaults them into the private system (AFP), so an expat expecting to stay in a home-country scheme must act quickly.

entity_title: The Carné de Extranjería is issued through the change of migratory status, not as a separate application
fact_text: The Carné de Extranjería is the document accrediting a foreigner as a Peruvian resident (enabling work, study, banking, health-system access, etc.). It is currently obtained via the change of migratory status: once the change is approved, the carné is printed.
evidence_quote: Actualmente, el carnet de extranjería se obtiene mediante el cambio de calidad migratoria.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: There is no standalone 'apply for the ID card' step: the Carné de Extranjería is a product of the migratory-status approval, so the residence ID timeline is tied to the calidad migratoria decision, not a separate queue.
